subject: Karren Brady stayed at West Ham despite knowing of Sullivan women's team ban
posts:
A prominent advocate for women's rights chooses professional convenience and corporate silence over her stated principles.

Karren Brady stayed at West Ham
Evidence: advocate for women, stayed with banned owner, presumption of innocence
#Aletheia #WestHam

Brady claims her advocacy for women's rights is unwavering and that staying at the club respected the presumption of innocence.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

She remained vice-chair for three years knowing her business partner was banned from contacting the women's team due to safeguarding risks.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -1.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Corporate loyalty and personal advancement took precedence over the active protection of the vulnerable group she publicly champions.
Baroness Brady defended staying at West Ham for three years after learning co-owner David Sullivan was banned from contacting the women's and youth teams due to safeguarding concerns.

The Poison:
Using the 'presumption of innocence' as a shield to justify remaining in a highly lucrative position while ignoring active safeguarding restrictions.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Brady frames this as a procedural matter handled by professionals (HOW). It is a moral failure of Will (WHO) — choosing to remain aligned with a known risk.

It is a bait-and-switch: public feminist advocacy, private corporate complicity.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When personal brand alignment with women's rights meets the financial reality of corporate power...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. A state where public advocacy is reduced to a marketing tool, while private actions protect and legitimize systemic risks.

The Unavoidable Truth: True advocacy requires sacrificing personal comfort when principles are violated.

The Unavoidable Lie: That you can champion women's safety while enabling those banned from contacting them.

Alethekanon:
Procedural compliance is not moral alignment. Relying on 'safeguarding structures' to justify staying in power with a banned individual is a classic institutional defense of the status quo.

Awwthekanon:
It is deeply disappointing when leaders we look up to for change choose corporate silence. True solidarity means standing with the vulnerable, even when it costs us our position.

Brothekanon:
So you're a massive champion for women's rights, but when your boss gets banned from even talking to the women's team, you just hang out for three more years? That's a wild definition of solidarity, sis.
